name: Maps
description: The places your {space} cares about (where to stay, where to eat, what to see) and a map of them, with the {objects} other {modules} put somewhere. Pick a spot to save a new place.
author: Coffee Pub

permissions.label: See the map and the places
Add, change and remove places, and put {objects} on the map

settings.label: Categories
settings.help: How places are grouped and coloured, in this order. Other is always there and holds any place whose category is not on the list; you can rename it but not remove it. Taking a category off the list removes no place and no type: its places show under Other, and its types stay in the picker. Grey keeps the automatic colour.

settings.label: Place search
settings.help: Where a search for a place by name is asked. The server sends nothing out unless you choose one.

options.label: Photon, the public service
options.help:
Every search is sent to the public Photon service at photon.komoot.io, and the server otherwise sends nothing out.
Their terms are "reasonable limits": extensive use may be throttled or banned, and there is no availability guarantee (https://github.com/komoot/photon).
Results come from OpenStreetMap data, so "© OpenStreetMap contributors" applies (the map already shows that credit).

options.label: My own address
options.help: Searches go to the address you give below: a Photon-compatible service you run or may use.

settings.label: Search address
settings.help: A Photon-compatible place search that you run or may use, over https (for example https://search.example.org/api).

settings.label: Save places in this {environment}
settings.help: Places a search returns are saved in this {environment} and shared by every {space}, so later searches use them first and the outside service is asked less. Only the place is kept, never who looked for it.

settings.label: Map files
settings.help: The PMTiles files the map is drawn from, all together. With {environments}, the files are the host's and only a host admin adds or cuts them (the host console); on a single server they are in this {module}'s map-tiles folder in the data folder, ticked here.

settings.label: Picture map
settings.help: A picture of an invented world, made into a PMTiles file of picture tiles. When set, the map shows only this picture, in every {space}, and place search looks only at saved places. Places saved before keep their positions, which will not mean anything on this picture. It is kept with this {environment}, so a backup carries it.

settings.label: World file, for cutting a region
settings.help: A world PMTiles file to cut a region from with "Add a region". The server reads only the part it cuts, over https range requests, never the whole file. Protomaps publishes a daily build at https://build.protomaps.com/YYYYMMDD.pmtiles, where YYYYMMDD is the build's date (https://build.protomaps.com/20261101.pmtiles, say); only recent builds are kept, so use a date from the last few weeks, or point this at your own stable copy. Left empty, cutting a region is off. With {environments} this is the host's, on the host console.

provides.name: addPlace
provides.label: Save it as a place
provides.description: Save a new place, with its position or address.

provides.name: setPlacePoint
provides.label: Give a place a position
provides.description: Give a saved place a position on the map, as a latitude and longitude.

provides.name: positionPicked
provides.label: Set the position of the place being added

provides.name: categoryColors
provides.label: Tell the colours chosen for categories

provides.name: mayAdd
provides.label: Tell whether this person may add places

provides.name: pickPoint
provides.label: Pick a spot on the map
